label: No definition
description: A tracker Yata has no definition for. Nothing is fetched and nothing is scraped until a type is chosen: the site's software can't be inferred from its URL, and guessing would mean sending a stream of requests it never answers. Trackers imported from Prowlarr or Jackett that match no definition land here. Pick the matching type — or use Detect, which tries each one with your own API key — and stats start on the next refresh.
